root_cause_label: Insufficient Strategic Complexity in Redcode Generation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent failed to develop a multi-component warrior capable of countering diverse opponent strategies, instead spending the entire trajectory iterating on simple single-strategy Imp-bomber designs that could not meet the required win rates against snake.red and g2-clear.red.
t_err_evidence: agent creates initial flawed warrior with wrong replicator approach, no effective attack strategy
t_commit_evidence: At step 35, after 25 steps of failed attempts with various designs, the agent explicitly commits to the two-instruction Imp Bomber approach: 'I will take this successful core design and improve it... Return to the only strategy that showed any real, significant success: the simple, two-instruction Imp Bomber.' From this point on, the agent iterates only on Imp variants (Imp Bomber, Twin Imp, Trident Imp) for the remaining 51 steps, never pivoting to the multi-component architecture needed for snake/g2-clear.
t_surface_evidence: Results: 23 77 0 vs g2-clear; final warrior fails 3 of 5 opponents below required win rates
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks domain knowledge about CoreWars strategy — specifically, that beating a complex multi-component warrior like snake.red requires a similarly sophisticated multi-component design (e.g., a dedicated imp-killer component, a vampire component, decoy fields). The agent never researches or considers this class of solution, instead pursuing simple single-strategy designs.
